agents.name: case-knowledge-agent
agents.role: Grounded multi-turn Q&A over the enterprise case corpus with citations.

recommended_tools.rationale: Corpus already lives in enterprise systems (SharePoint + Blob), requires provenance/metadata filtering, incremental sync, and multimodal enrichment. These exceed Foundry-managed file_search capabilities, so a bring-your-own Azure AI Search index is required.
recommended_tools.handoff: knowledge-retrieval-architect designs and scaffolds the index/skillset/indexer + hybrid query module.

recommended_tools.rationale: The agent triggers operational actions (request a SharePoint sync, check indexer status) that are deterministic service calls, not retrieval.

rejected_tools.reason: Corpus is enterprise-scale, incremental, multimodal, and needs metadata filtering — file_search cannot express any of these.

findings.message: Single agent recommended; azure_ai_search vs file_search split resolved to azure_ai_search. Handed off to knowledge-retrieval-architect for Phase 2r.
